jobs.title: Computational Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
About the Company

About AlignedAt Aligned, we partner with the world's leading AI labs to push the frontier of AI knowledge in fields like STEM, medicine, finance, and the humanities. Our platform matches subject-matter experts (like you) with paid consulting work on frontier projects at these labs.

About the Role

We are looking to expand our team of expert consultants with 12 PhD Environmental Scientists for part-time, fully-remote work supporting frontier AI research. This role includes stress-testing leading AI models on research-level environmental science problems, creating and verifying complex questions and explanations in your area of expertise, and assessing whether AI-generated reasoning meets the standards of a trained environmental scientist.

Responsibilities

Stress-testing leading AI models on research-level environmental science problems
Creating complex questions and explanations in your area of expertise
Verifying complex questions and explanations in your area of expertise
Assessing whether AI-generated reasoning meets the standards of a trained environmental scientist

Qualifications

You hold a PhD in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related field, and you are actively engaged in computational research.

Required Skills

Fluent English reading and writing skills
PhD in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related field
Hands-on experience in computational modeling, simulation, or large-scale data analysis
You build or apply quantitative models and work with large environmental datasets.

Preferred Skills

Faculty, postdoctoral researchers, and research scientists in university environmental science, environmental engineering, or earth and environmental systems departments
Scientists at government agencies such as the EPA, USGS, or equivalent national environmental and water agencies
Researchers at national laboratories or research institutes working on environmental modeling and simulation
Industry scientists in environmental consulting, water resources, energy, or corporate sustainability and risk analytics

Pay range and compensation package

Projects start at $60-80 USD per hour, with top-performing experts on our platform earning $150+ USD / hour.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Information about an equal opportunity statement is not provided in the job description.

jobs.title: Environmental Specialist I
jobs.description:
Company Description

Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country's largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

Job Description

Position Purpose:

This position provides specialized transportation and disposal services to our clients. Responsibilities include manifesting, packaging, spill response, labeling, loading/unloading, coordinating transportation, and sampling/profiling material while adhering to state and federal environmental, health, and safety regulations.

Primary Duties /Responsibilities

Sample waste streams according to prescribed policies and procedures.
Manifesting, packaging, spill clean-up response and remedial activities, labeling, loading, off loading, and coordinating transportation.
Maintain a professional image to clients by answering inquiries and suggesting solutions to existing/potential problems.
Comply and enforce all compliance, health, safety, and procedures in accordance with VES-TS policies.
Become familiar with all U. S. Department of Transportation (DOT)/Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and VES-TS regulations required in submitting paperwork to expedite disposal of hazardous waste.
Operate and maintain all equipment in a professional manner to ensure optimum efficiency and effectiveness.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education / Experience / Background:

High School diploma or General Educational Development (GED) required
Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a related science discipline preferred

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Strong team player
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Time management: the ability to organize and manage multiple deadlines
Strong customer service orientation
Computer proficiency
Ability to follow through on assignments.

Required Certification / Licenses / Training

40-hour HAZWOPER Certification
Valid Driver's License
Ability to obtain a Class A or B Commercial Drivers License (CDL) with Hazardous (H) endorsement

Additional Information

Benefits:
Veolia's comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Environmental Scientist

Brisbane or Cairns QLD

RPS, A Tetra Tech company

RPS, A Tetra Tech company, is a global professional services firm delivering projects that define, shape and manage Australia's most important infrastructure, development and environmental initiatives.

With more than 5,000 professionals across 125 countries, we bring together technical excellence, practical thinking and a collaborative approach to solve complex challenges across infrastructure, energy, water, environment, urban development and resources.

Our Oceans & Environment team partners with government and private sector clients to deliver innovative environmental solutions that support sustainable development while protecting our natural environment.

The Opportunity

Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Senior Environmental Scientist to join our Oceans & Environment team in our Brisbane or Cairns offices.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of infrastructure, renewable energy, transport, water and development projects across Queensland and Australia. You will collaborate with experienced environmental consultants and technical specialists to deliver environmental assessments, approvals and management solutions that help clients achieve successful project outcomes.

Whether you enjoy field work, technical reporting, environmental approvals or working closely with clients, this role offers excellent variety and the opportunity to grow your career within a supportive national team.

What You Will Be Doing

Preparing environmental assessments, technical reports and environmental management plans.
Assisting with environmental impact assessments and planning approval documentation.
Conducting environmental investigations, literature reviews and data analysis.
Supporting environmental approvals under Queensland and Commonwealth legislation.
Coordinating inputs from technical specialists and project stakeholders.
Working collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams.
Building strong relationships with clients, regulators and internal stakeholders.
Assisting with project planning, budgeting and delivery to meet client expectations.
Supporting proposal preparation and business development activities.
Ensuring work is delivered safely on time and to a high technical standard.

About You

You will be passionate about delivering practical environmental outcomes and enjoy working on a wide variety of projects in a collaborative consulting environment.

You Will Also Bring

A degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Management or a related discipline.
Experience working in environmental consulting, government or a related industry.
Knowledge of Queensland environmental legislation and environmental assessment processes.
An understanding of the Commonwealth Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999 (EPBC Act).
Strong technical report writing and communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly.
Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
A collaborative approach and a commitment to delivering quality outcomes for clients.
A current Australian driver's licence and willingness to undertake occasional field work and travel as required.

Why Join RPS?

At RPS, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive workplace where you can develop your career while contributing to projects that create lasting value for our communities.

We Offer

Professional development and career progression opportunities
A supportive team culture that celebrates collaboration and success
Flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance
Active wellbeing and community engagement initiatives
Annual professional membership reimbursement
Paid parental and partner leave
$250 active lifestyle allowance per annum
Additional annual leave purchase scheme and salary packaging options
Professional and technical development programs, including study assistance, online learning and mentoring across portfolios
Active office social events, Employee Assistance Program, service recognition and more

Our Commitment

At RPS, everyone is empowered to bring their best. We foster a workplace where different perspectives are valued, collaboration is encouraged and people are supported to grow professionally.

As part of Tetra Tech, we combine local knowledge with global expertise to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients while creating opportunities for our people.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you are looking to build your environmental consulting career with a respected global consultancy and work on projects that make a real difference across Queensland and beyond, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape a more sustainable future with RPS, A Tetra Tech company.

Our Approach

Our people live our purpose, deliver our promise, and demonstrate our behaviours every day. Our behaviours define who we are. Developed by our people, they underpin everything that we do. They create the memorable experiences we are known for and make RPS a great place to do great work.

Stronger together is one of our five core behaviours and it is key to building a collaborative workplace. We encourage everyone to bring their best and to support others to do the same. By sharing knowledge, challenging each other to think differently, and fostering an environment of trust and respect, our people can learn, grow and thrive – and share in our success.

Recruitment Agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on this list. Please refer to the careers page on our website if you require any further information.
